## Regional expertise

Content and methods are built around coastal Central Florida conditions:
intense UV exposure, high year-round humidity, salt air near the coast,
frequent stucco cracking from heat expansion and sandy-soil settling, and
mildew/algae growth. Product guidance favors 100% acrylic and elastomeric
coatings, mildew-resistant finishes, and prep-first workmanship.
